mn131:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn131:2.1: bhaddekarattassa vo bhikkhave uddesañca vibhaṅgañca desissāmi
mn131:2.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn131:4.2: evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti evaṃsañño ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti.
mn131:5.2: evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti evaṃsañño ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti evaṃsaṅkhāro ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti.
mn131:6.2: evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti evaṃvedano siyaṃ …pe… evaṃsañño siyaṃ …pe… evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ …pe… evaṃ viññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti.
mn131:7.2: evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti evaṃvedano siyaṃ …pe… evaṃsañño siyaṃ …pe… evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ …pe… evaṃ viññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti.
mn131:8.2: idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
mn131:8.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
mn131:8.7: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn131:8.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhirati.
mn131:9.1: kathañca bhikkhave paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhirati.
mn131:9.2: idha bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
mn131:9.3: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
mn131:9.7: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn131:9.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhave paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhirati.
mn131:11.1: bhaddekarattassa vo bhikkhave uddesañca vibhaṅgañca desissāmīti.
mn131:11.2: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttanti.
mn131:11.4: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
